title: A follow-up that goes quiet raises an alarm

verify.note: Fails today: the heartbeat proves the cron ran, not that it sent anything.

detail: The drip crons ping their heartbeat when they run, even when nothing is enrolled. Space drips have no enrollments and the journey drip last sent on 2026-08-13, and nothing noticed. Add a silence check per follow-up (sent-in-window versus enrolled-and-due) and one end-to-end enrol-and-send check for Space and journey drips.
